# GMEOW Creative Works Module

The GMEOW Creative Works Module — classes, properties, and individuals of the GMEOW super-vocabulary.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/creative-works>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:slices/creative-works`  

**Type:** `owl:Ontology`  

The WEMI spine for creative and intellectual works — Work, Expression,
Manifestation, Item — reconstructed from native GMEOW primitives (frame-relativity,
reified events, relators, standpoints) and bridged to FRBR/LRMoo/CIDOC/schema.org
by reference (Principle 5), never by axiom import.

DOCTRINE.
  * The four tiers are gufo:Kinds with distinct identity criteria (Work=abstract
    content, Expression=language/notation frame, Manifestation=edition/format,
    Item=single copy); CreativeWork is the gufo:Category umbrella over them.
  * Expression variance is carried by gmeow:hasReferenceFrame (language, script,
    notation, arrangement) — never a subclass taxonomy (Principle 9).
  * Creation is a reified gmeow:Event with an eventType value — no Event subclasses
    (Principle 12).
  * Contribution is a reified gmeow:Relator with flat shortcuts for the 80% case
    (flat-first, reify-on-demand).
  * Format, role, genre, and medium are open value vocabularies (individuals),
    never subclasses (Principle 9).
  * No primary/privileged title or edition (Principle 9); suppressed titles and
    withdrawn standpoints use gmeow:displayable false (Principle 10).
  * Complex lineage (translations-as-versions, collected volumes, withdrawn
    releases) reuses the generic VersionSet / VersionMembership machinery (#161).

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/creative-works>
